info.title: SJewls Customer Mobile API
info.description: API endpoints for the SJewls Customer Mobile Application — Contact Verification, OTP Request & Verification, Profile Completion, Self-Service Account Closure, and Active Branches.

get.description: Retrieves all currently active branches for customer registration, store location selection, and mobile lookups.

post.summary: Check if contact exists in database and determine next step (Login or Register)
post.description: Verifies the phone number or email address against existing customers in the database. Returns whether the customer exists, profile completion state, and recommended next action ('Login' or 'Register').

post.summary: Request verification OTP via Phone (Text.lk SMS) or Email (Gmail SMTP)
post.description:
Generates and dispatches a 6-digit verification code to the specified contact.

**Delivery Modes:**
• **Email Address**: Dispatched via real Gmail SMTP (`smtp.gmail.com:587`, STARTTLS) from `w.sagee5@gmail.com` with subject 'Your SJewls verification code'. Returns 200 OK only after the SMTP server explicitly accepts the message. If delivery fails (e.g., SMTP auth/network failure), the challenge is immediately invalidated and a safe 400 error is returned (no fallback to mock).
• **Phone Number**: Dispatched via real Text.lk SMS Gateway (`https://app.text.lk/api/v3/sms/send`, Bearer auth) with sender ID `TextLKDemo`. Returns 200 OK only after the SMS gateway accepts delivery. On failure, the challenge is immediately invalidated and a safe 400 error is returned.

**Outcomes & Error Responses:**
• `200 OK`: Verification code successfully accepted by delivery provider. Valid for 5 minutes (resend cooldown 60 seconds).
• `400 Bad Request`: Active resend cooldown in effect, invalid phone/email format, or provider delivery failure.

post.summary: Verify submitted OTP code and authenticate or continue registration
post.description:
Verifies the submitted 6-digit OTP against active challenges.

**Outcomes & Responses:**
• `200 OK (nextAction: 'Dashboard')`: Customer exists and profile is complete. Returns JWT access token, refresh token, and customer details.
• `200 OK (nextAction: 'CompleteProfile')`: Customer is new or profile is incomplete. Returns temporary 1-hour `registrationToken`.
• `400 Bad Request`: Verification code incorrect (attempts decremented, max 5 allowed), challenge expired (after 5 minutes), or challenge already consumed.
• `401 Unauthorized`: Customer account is deactivated or closed.

Finalizes customer registration using the registrationToken. Automatically preserves the initially entered OTP-verified contact and saves any provided secondary email/phone number. Requires FullName, DateOfBirth (18+), and valid Sri Lankan NIC. Returns JWT access and refresh tokens.

post.description: Rotates the refresh token and returns a new active access token.

get.description: Retrieves active jewellery categories for the customer's registered branch, including counts of currently available plans.
Returns currently available jewellery plans for a specific category. Plans whose admin start date is in the future are strictly excluded.
Retrieves active, currently available jewellery plans for the customer's branch, optionally filtered by category.
Retrieves details of an individual plan including target gold grams, offered durations, and premium percentage.

post.description: Returns a proposed enrolment confirmation summary containing plan snapshot, target grams, premium percentage, proposed joining date and deadline.
Creates an active enrolment immediately without requiring an initial payment. Idempotent across retries with the same IdempotencyKey. Triggers an activation notification.

get.description: Retrieves paginated jewellery plan enrolments for the authenticated customer, showing target grams, net accumulated gold, remaining grams, and contribution availability.
Retrieves full details and progress metrics for a specific enrolment owned by the customer.
Retrieves the confirmed contribution and payment ledger history for this jewellery plan enrolment.

post.description: Calculates an informational calculation preview for Buy Gram or Buy Amount mode without altering balances or creating a quote.
Locks an authoritative payment quote for 5 minutes at the latest applicable gold rate. Guarantees payable amount and credited grams during validity.

get.description: Retrieves the status, values, and expiry of a locked payment quote.

post.summary: Initiate payment for locked quote (Gateway Deferred)
post.description: Gateway integration is deferred. Returns PaymentProviderNotConfigured (HTTP 501). No fake checkout URL is generated, and balances remain unchanged.

get.description: Retrieves paginated notifications for the customer (such as jewellery plan activations and completions).

post.description: Marks an individual customer notification as read.
Marks all unread notifications for the customer as read.

get.description: Retrieves customer full name, date of birth, NIC, phone number, email address, verification statuses, and primary branch.

post.summary: Request OTP to verify secondary profile contact (Email or Phone)
post.description:
Sends a 6-digit OTP to the customer's unverified secondary contact (email or phone).

**Delivery Modes:**
• **Email Address**: Dispatched via real Gmail SMTP (`smtp.gmail.com:587`, STARTTLS) from `w.sagee5@gmail.com`. Invalidates challenge and returns safe 400 error on delivery failure.
• **Phone Number**: Dispatched via real Text.lk SMS Gateway (`https://app.text.lk/api/v3/sms/send`, Bearer auth) with sender ID `TextLKDemo`. Invalidates challenge and returns safe 400 error on delivery failure.

**Outcomes & Error Responses:**
• `200 OK`: Verification code successfully dispatched.
• `400 Bad Request`: Delivery failure or invalid contact.
• `404 Not Found`: Customer or pending contact not found.
• `409 Conflict`: Contact already verified.

post.summary: Verify and activate secondary contact for login
post.description: Submits the OTP for the additional contact. Once verified, this contact is activated and can also be used for customer login.

post.summary: Request OTP for customer self-service account closure
post.description: Initiates customer self-service account closure by dispatching a fresh OTP to the customer's verified contact. The challenge is cryptographically bound to the AccountClosure purpose and cannot be substituted with a login OTP.

post.summary: Confirm self-service account closure using OTP
post.description: Confirms soft closure of the customer account with fresh OTP verification. Marks status as Inactive, records CustomerRequestedClosure timestamp, revokes all active sessions/refresh tokens, and retains all financial, plan, and audit histories for regulatory compliance.
